note: The bank's pre-defined monitoring limits per MMSG criterion. The MMSG asks for a list of metrics compared against pre-defined limits (MMG 2.11.1) and leaves the values to the bank; the values below are this bank's policy, not numbers taken from the MMSG. Gini, KS, calibration, PSI, CSI and override limits are the validation engine's own thresholds (backend/scorecard_v5/engine.py), so monitoring and validation never disagree.

references.discrimination: MMG 2.7.5 (accuracy ratio / Gini as the discriminatory-power metric); MMG 2.11.2 (track the change in discriminatory power against a maximum acceptable drop)
references.calibration: MMG 2.11.1 (metrics compared against pre-defined limits); MMS 3.6.3 (monitoring metrics, limits and reporting per model)
references.stability: MMS 3.6.3 (whether changes in the economic and business environment affect the model's assumptions and performance)
references.overrides: MMS 3.5.3 (an approved, controlled override policy); MMG 2.10.1-2.10.2 (override limits; the validator measures the frequency of overrides and their notches)
references.migration: MMG 2.11.1 (performance and stability metrics against pre-defined limits)
references.data_quality: MMG 2.11.3 (i) and (vi) (development and validation data in the scope of a validation)
references.usage: MMS 3.5.1-3.5.2 (conditions for using models defined, monitored and managed; expected usage and its control); MMS 3.6.2 (appropriate use confirmed before performance monitoring)
references.cycle: MMS 3.7.1 (all models validated on a regular basis by model type; minimum frequencies in MMS Part II, Article 10); the cycle months below are this bank's policy and are to be checked against the MMS Article 10 table
references.findings: MMS 3.7.10 (high-severity findings remedied promptly; adjustments and overrides must not become regular practice)
references.reporting: MMS 3.6.4 (monitoring reports to the Model Oversight Committee at least every quarter); MMS 3.6.6 (each report carries an explicit conclusion on model performance)
references.decisions: MMS 4.3.3 (after validation: leave the model unchanged, a temporary adjustment with a remediation plan, recalibrate, redevelop or acquire, or withdraw)
references.conclusion: MMS 3.7.8 (a validation results in a fully articulated judgement on the suitability of the model)
references.tiering: MMS 3.1.5 and 4.4.5 (models grouped by model risk into at least two tiers)

discrimination.title: Discrimination
discrimination.what: Does the score still rank good and bad customers apart?

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.what: Do the grade PDs match the defaults that happened?

stability.title: Stability
stability.what: Has the scored population moved away from the one the scorecard was built on?

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.what: How often do officers override the score, why, and how do the overridden cases perform?

migration.title: Grade migration and concentration
migration.what: Are grades moving or bunching in a way the model did not expect?

data_quality.title: Data quality
data_quality.what: Are the inputs complete and inside the ranges the model knows?

usage.title: Use against intended scope
usage.what: Is the scorecard used only where it was built and approved to be used?

cycle.title: Validation cycle
cycle.what: Is the last full independent validation inside the cycle for the model's tier?

findings.title: Open findings
findings.what: Are earlier validation findings being fixed by their due dates?

gini_drop_rel.label: Relative fall in Gini since development

migration_2notch.label: Share moving two or more grades in a year

grade_max_share.label: Largest single-grade share of the scored population

missing_inputs.label: Largest missing rate of a model input

unseen_bins.label: Rows with an input outside the development ranges

missing_outcome.label: Matured rows without a recorded outcome

out_of_scope.label: Scored population outside the approved scope

cycle_used.label: Months since the last full independent validation, share of the tier's cycle

findings_overdue.label: Open findings past their due date
